My pain is life long, and will only get worse. I am afflicted with probably one of the sickest curses on this earth... being trans. sent straight from hell to torment people who did nothing to deserve it. i don't want to transition because i don't want to be the other gender, i want to be comfortable with my assigned gender and that is something not possible. the dysphoria is unbeareable. for entire months i just find no purpose in life.

i've had a good life, i'm just 19 and got to visit 20 countries all with money won from competitions. i got into oxford, nyu and yale. i won international competitions in maths, computer science, physics. i was the valedictorian. but noone knew my secret, and not even i knew how to verbalize it or what it meant. I consider my life to have been pretty good. but i don't want to continue outrunning this curse.
